approval_note: Ranking-first showcase: Buying, Browsing, and Intent Override each expose three official multi-turn traces. One-turn cases are removed from the primary recommendation story.

canonical_cases.label: Answer unlocks the target
canonical_cases.description: Outside Top-10 on Turns 1–2; the material answer moves the target to Rank #1 on Turn 3.

canonical_cases.label: Rich preference bundle
canonical_cases.description: A detailed color and material answer brings a previously absent watch to Rank #1.

canonical_cases.label: Four-turn refinement
canonical_cases.description: The target stays outside Top-10 for three turns, then the closure answer moves it to Rank #2.

canonical_cases.label: Six-turn exploration
canonical_cases.description: Vague browsing becomes leather, brown, rubber, casual, and soft; the target enters at Rank #1 on Turn 6.

canonical_cases.label: Material clarification
canonical_cases.description: The target is absent for two turns; a polyester and spandex answer moves it to Rank #1.

canonical_cases.label: Fast clarification
canonical_cases.description: A vague shorts request becomes specific after one stretch-feature answer and reaches Rank #1.

canonical_cases.label: Reset, then recover
canonical_cases.description: Remove the earlier stainless-steel preference, continue refining, and bring the target from outside Top-10 to Rank #1 on Turn 5.

canonical_cases.label: Rank #5 to Rank #1
canonical_cases.description: Material evidence moves the target from #5 to #1; override then removes cotton and polyester while retaining wool.

canonical_cases.label: Rewrite multiple slots
canonical_cases.description: Remove black, comfortable, and lightweight; add stainless steel and hypoallergenic; the scored target reaches Rank #1.

canonical_cases.label: No-preference boundary
canonical_cases.description: An explicit no-preference answer is handled without losing the valid category state.
